item.title: US Bans Chinese AI DeepSeek Across Civilian Government IT Systems
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Washington draws a hard line on artificial intelligence. The US Department of Homeland Security has officially ordered the removal and procurement ban of China's DeepSeek across all civilian IT systems, citing severe data transfer and espionage risks.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The directive mandates the immediate removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services leveraging the model from all civilian federal networks. [SPLIT] ⚡ Federal agencies were previously instructed via a July memo to aggressively monitor inbound and outbound traffic flows to isolate DeepSeek signatures. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/us-bans-chinese-ai-deepseek-across-civilian-government-it-systems-520604.html

item.title: Autonomous Swarms: The AI Agent Breaches Reshaping Cyber Defense
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
An anonymous hacker used an army of autonomous AI agents to breach over 100 enterprise websites, including industrial giants like John Deere and Cummins. We examine the operational reality of automated cyber warfare.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Targeted industrial heavyweights included John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins, though respective spokespersons reported varying degrees of containment and data exposure. item.title: Anthropic Breaks Ranks With Draft AI Law in US Capital

item.title: Marines Field Next-Gen Tech to Survive the Post-Golden Hour Battlefield

item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ The Marine Corps has deployed the Expeditionary Medical Refrigeration Unit (EMRU) and MEQU mobile blood warmers to maintain forward cold-chain distribution without heavy generators. [SPLIT] ⚡ Point-of-care ultrasound systems like the KOSMOS are being integrated to rapidly detect internal bleeding on the battlefield. item.description:
